an6.22:1.1: bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha . . . 2.
an6.22:1.2: Katame ca bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā?
an6.22:1.3: Na kammārāmatā, na bhassārāmatā, na niddārāmatā, na saṅgaṇikārāmatā, sovacassatā, kalyāṇamittatā.
an6.22:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā. 3.
an6.22:2.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.22:2.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānaṃ na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.22:2.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te ime heva chahi dhammehi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehī ti. 1.
